text_block_list.text:
One day, El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder 
were doing independent training.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, that's what happens when you push 
recklessly from the start... You need to 
pace yourself."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... Even though Trainer came up with a 
new training regimen for me, I can't even 
see it through!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Aha! YES! Don't we have THAT?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Wait, El, where are you going...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hoataaah!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Shocking Rapid-Fire Fierce Strike Wave—!! 
Condor Monk has arrrriiiived!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I wondered what she ran off to do... Why 
did she go and change her clothes?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No-no! Grass just doesn't get it, no-no!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Very well! It'll be faster to show you 
than explain it, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hoochaaaah!!

With that, El Condor Pasa ran a full lap 
around the track and returned.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
How's this! Both my spirits and stamina 
are right at their peak! Power is surging 
up endlessly, yeeesss!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Incredible... But, why...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to this outfit, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Wearing the garb of a monk with an 
unyielding spirit fills El with sheer 
power, desu!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
For a warrior, an outfit is both a 
guidepost to their goal and an admonition 
to themselves to strive for its 
achievement, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
These are words Papa once used when 
talking about pro wrestling gear, but the 
meaning should be the same, yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see. Even so, I can understand how you 
feel.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Slipping into a kimono always brings me 
such peace of mind, too.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! You understand too, Grass? Starting 
with the aesthetics has meaning too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna try on all kinds of outfits and 
become the invincible, ultimate El Condor 
Pasa, *desu*!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. But what should I wear to become 
stronger, yes?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...And so! Trainer-san! I've dropped by 
completely out of the blue, desu!"
choice_data_list:
That was so sudden, it really surprised 
me...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To get straight to it! What kind of outfit 
should El wear to become even stronger, 
desu ka?
choice_data_list: Wrap yourself in composure with a kimono
Put on a training uniform and get to work!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I see! If that's how it is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...I want Grass, who knows so much about 
kimonos, to teach me all sorts of things, 
DESU!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Gladly. I'll pick out something that looks 
great on you, El♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we learn the 'spirit of harmony' 
while we're at it? I believe it would hone 
your composure even further.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ooh! What specifically should we do, yes?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
First is basic seiza posture. I believe it 
should help you find calmness and 
composure.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: S-Seiza kneeling!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"That makes my legs all tingly and numb, 
so... But if it'll make me stronger... 
mmmph~!"

And so, El Condor Pasa was left clutching 
her head, agonizing over the heavy price 
of strength.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, a dogi! I have seen them in old 
movies, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's what you wear when you punch 
waterfalls and stuff, YES?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it right away! El's fists will 
split that waterfall wide open, yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What you wear for waterfall meditation is 
white ascetic robes, but... More 
importantly, El... what about the 
waterfall?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Was it!? Is there a waterfall 
nearby... None... Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, just putting on the outfit 
shifts your mindset, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...YES! Thank you, Grass! I almost forgot 
something very important!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Let's wear dogi for training next time! 
Even if it's not waterfall training, it 
should still be effective, desu!"

A few days later, El Condor Pasa reported 
back that training in a martial arts gi 
had been an absolute blast.
